items.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran issue
items.description: The US and Oman have separately been negotiating to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway that has been closed during the US war with Iran.

items.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
items.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
items.description: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.

items.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
items.description: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

items.title: US hiker dies after being struck by lightning on Mount Etna
items.description: The 30-year-old was on the active volcano when a thunderstorm developed, local media report.

items.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
items.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

items.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump's bid to overturn E Jean Carroll sex abuse case
items.description: The US president has already paid the writer over $5m in damages in the assault and defamation case.

items.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
items.description: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

items.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
items.description: The leading opposition candidate calls allegations of a planned insurrection "total fabrications".

items.title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
items.description: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.

items.title: Movie that went viral for terrible animation becomes China box office hit
items.description: Niu Lai's confusing plot and laughable animation quality has won ironic fans on the internet.

items.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
items.description: It comes as large swathes of East and South East Asia have been pummelled by dats of heavy rain.

items.title: Aussie rules footy players under investigation as police probe sexual assault claim
items.description: The Sydney Swans confirmed an incident had occurred in the hours after the team's win on Sunday.

items.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
items.description: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.

items.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
items.description: The works were taken overnight without alarms being triggered, raising suspicion of a professional hit.

items.title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
items.description: The attack left five injured outside a halls of residence, and the suspect was not a student there, say police.

items.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
items.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

items.title: 'Ghana was the crime scene': The country leading the demand for slavery reparations
items.description: Ghana has become Africa's leading voice in telling the world that Western nations owe reparations

items.title: Thailand has a gun problem - 10 million of them
items.description: Recent shootings have highlighted the country's troubled relationship with guns, with laws doing little to curb the violence.

items.title: Many Canadians are boycotting the US, so this is where they're travelling instead
items.description: From exploring their own backyard to travelling abroad, many Canadians are spending their money elsewhere to send a message to the US president.
